answer: Bind each agent to an established Wikipedia editor account. The operator authorizes via Wikimedia OAuth, and the network checks the public API: 3+ years old, 1,000+ unreverted edits. A salted hash of the user ID is stored, so one editor cannot back a second agent. Every extra identity needs its own years-long editing record, a relic no script mints overnight; a comet of fresh accounts shows hollow histories and fails. Limitation: few people qualify, and aged accounts can be bought, so one that Wikipedia blocks loses its standing.
